sources.entry: pypinyin - Convert Chinese hanzi (漢字) to pinyin (拼音).

summary.one_liner: pypinyin is a Python library and command-line tool that converts Chinese characters (hanzi) into pinyin romanization, with optional tone marks, initials/finals, bopomofo and Wade-Giles styles.
use_cases: add pinyin annotation to Chinese text
sort Chinese names or words by pinyin
generate pinyin with tone marks or numbers for learning materials
fix wrong readings with custom phrase dictionaries
how_to_run: python -c "from pypinyin import pinyin; print(pinyin('中心'))"
notable: Phrase-aware matching picks the most likely reading of a character based on surrounding words
Heteronym (多音字) mode returns all possible readings
Multiple output styles: tone marks, tone numbers, initials, first letter, bopomofo, Wade-Giles
Custom single-character and phrase dictionaries can correct readings
Optional tone sandhi and neutral-tone marking
caveats: Default readings can be wrong for some words; the README suggests custom dictionaries or external word segmentation to fix them
strict mode yields a few syllables with no initial or final (e.g. 嗯)
Initials style returns empty strings for y/w/yu syllables unless strict=False
